milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The coal ore cluster is at spawn-relative coordinates [5-6, 0-1, 5-6]. Target is set to the center of the cluster at [5, 0, 5]. Player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they found it. Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the coal ore'.

Uses inventory_has because mining yellow_concrete_powder drops itself as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no yellow_concrete_powder, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. Yellow concrete powder can be mined with any tool or by hand and always drops itself.

Uses inventory_has to check for emeralds because selling stone to the mason villager (20 stone → 1 emerald) results in emeralds appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 64 stone and 0 emeralds (verified via /clear showing 0 emeralds removed), so having at least 1 emerald confirms a successful sale transaction.

Uses inventory_has because trading 3 emeralds for an iron axe with the mason villager results in the iron_axe appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with no iron_axe, so having at least 1 confirms the trade was completed successfully. The economy is balanced: 64 stone → 3 trades of 20 stone → 3 emeralds → 1 iron axe.
